frank: Heads-up from a partner call 1: the model-onboarding guide has a broken tutorial link to the quantization walkthrough and an old CLI example that uses `redwood model push --format float16` (we now use `--quant ql4`).

lina: ouch. where's the bad link?

frank: /handbook/model-onboarding.html -> the "quantization walkthrough" anchor goes to a 404 fragment (#quant-walkthrough). also the CLI block shows:
```bash
redwood model push my-model --format float16 --region us-east-1
```
should be:
```bash
redwood model push my-model --quant ql4 --region us-east-1
```
This tripped up a partner trying to onboard a trimmed model.

jorge: I can take the doc edit. plan: update the anchor slug to `quant-walkthrough-v2`, add a 301 redirect for the old fragment, and replace the CLI snippet. I'll also add a lightweight docs CI smokecheck that fetches the page and looks for `--quant ql4` in the rendered HTML.

frank: can you also add a one-line migration note for partners who might still use float16? they had some runtime confusion.

jorge: will do. tagging @docs-owners for an owner assign and to confirm redirect policy.

docs-owners: assigning owner: @platform-docs (lina). Please add frontmatter owner and a changelog line.

lina: thanks 1. jorge, pls also add the redirect mapping to redirects.yml and email partner-ops so they know we changed the fragment.

jorge: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1678 "model-onboarding: fix quantization link, update CLI snippet, add redirect and smokecheck". Included nginx redirect entry and a one-liner smokecheck in CI.

ci-bot: Docs CI queued for PR #1678 at 2025-08-14T14:02:00Z  build #5120

frank: small ask: can we also add a doc-lint rule that flags `--format float16` usage in docs? we keep seeing stale CLI flags.

lina: yes, add to backlog. i'll create DOCS-302 to add a linter rule and a CI warning for deprecated CLI flags.

deploy-bot: Staging deploy queued by jorge at 2025-08-14T14:05:12Z  staging build 5120

ci-bot: Docs CI passed  smokecheck OK (found "--quant ql4")

deploy-bot: Staging deploy succeeded at 2025-08-14T14:07:05Z  build 5120

frank: validated staging: anchor resolves to the new section and the CLI snippet shows `--quant ql4`. migration note added. thanks!

lina: will merge after one quick LGTM on the redirect TTL. prefer 90 days 301 for public links.

jorge: set TTL to 90 days, 301 mapping added. merging after LGTM.

docs-owners: acked, merging. please follow up with DOCS-302 for the linter.

frank: great turnaround, cheers everyone :clap:
